Grace — thanks for the files. A few clarifications before the walkthrough so we can focus the 30 minutes: 

1) Encryption: Your matrix states "AES-256 at rest" and "TLS1.3 in transit". Can you confirm key management responsibilities (customer KMS vs Redwood-held keys) for Dedicated and Private deployment options? Also, describe key rotation cadence and observable artifacts that show rotation completed.

2) Access control: We need one example of an access review report for an account admin role and the retention policy for access logs (where are logs stored and for how long?).

3) Incident & escalation: Provide an example timeline (sanitized) for a P1 incident that impacted inference latency and the post-incident RCA responsibility split between Redwood and the customer's ops team.

4) Change control evidence: In the matrix a few items cite "deployment tickets" — can you point to a typical ticket export (redacted) showing approvals and smoke-test results?

If you can attach short artifacts addressing 1–4 prior to Thu, that will help the walkthrough be a short confirmation rather than an evidence deep-dive.

Regards,
Jonas Meyer
Lead IT Auditor
Cedar Federal Bank
